analysis.rationale: 单 pair0 (k=1): saturate_weaken_HSV:4 模拟与 degraded_0.png 像素级完全一致 (PSNR=inf, MSE=0, CI 10/10 全部 diff=0). 信号: saturation_chroma_ratio=0.2001 (HSV sev4 S scale=0.2), variance_ratio=0.589, brightness_detected=false; block_boundary=0.990/unique_G 未降排除 JPEG; gm_ratio=1.046/slope_ratio=1.050 排除 blur; noise_prior sigma=0.25 且剥离后残差恒零排除 noise. 确定性单步退化 → Tier 1, PSNR>=40dB → LIKELY.
